headline: Continental Controls rights issue at ₹10
summary: Continental Controls Ltd announced a rights issue of 1.96 crore shares at ₹10 per share to raise ₹19.66 crore. Record date is October 14, 2026.

headline: Nasscom addresses US green card suspension
summary: Nasscom clarifies that immigration and skilled talent mobility are distinct issues, noting Indian tech firms have reduced H-1B dependence.

headline: Oseaspre to seek EGM approval for capital hike
summary: Oseaspre Consultants plans an EGM on October 30, 2026, to approve raising authorised capital to ₹70 lakh and issuing shares on a preferential basis.

headline: Stocks to Watch Today: TCS, NCC, Lupin, Jaykay in focus
summary: TCS flags margin pressure despite AI growth; NCC wins ₹1,286 Cr order but slips. Lupin gains FDA approval while Jaykay drops 8.8% on subsidiary funding news.

headline: Gravita India forms Green Maputo Recyclers in Mozambique
summary: Gravita India has incorporated a new entity, Green Maputo Recyclers, in Mozambique to expand its recycling operations in the African market.

headline: FSSAI sends notices to Dr. Reddy's, Nestle, Amazon, Flipkart
summary: FSSAI has issued notices to Dr. Reddy's, Nestle Health Science, Amazon, and Flipkart over claims related to Celevida GLP+, signalling regulatory scrutiny of the product.

headline: Highway Infra wins ₹24.46 crore toll contract from NHAI
summary: Highway Infra has secured a toll operations contract worth ₹24.46 crore from the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI).

headline: Anthem BSE block trade: ~30 lakh shares at ₹833
summary: A block trade of approximately 30,00,000 shares of Anthem was executed on BSE at ₹833.00 per share, aggregating to ₹249.90 crore.

headline: Tourism Finance Corporation shares flag large trade
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 2,117,122 shares of Tourism Finance Corporation of India changing hands on BSE at ₹146.05, with a combined value of ₹30.92 crore.

headline: Cubical Financial Services open offer sees negligible acceptance
summary: Cubical Financial Services Ltd saw only 1,321 shares tendered in its open offer for 26% equity. Acquirers Manoj Agrawal and Amit Kumar Saraogi now hold 68.94% post-offer.

headline: Mirza International sets up footwear subsidiary
summary: Mirza International Limited has incorporated Mirza Global Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary to expand its footwear manufacturing and retail operations.

headline: Sun Pharma shares flag large-trade signal on NSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~96,878 Sun Pharma shares changing hands on NSE at ₹1,773.00, with a combined value of ₹17.18 crore.
